boundary: If the disclosed record held no health data (only campaign contact details), Privacy / Confidentiality alone would clearly be right; the gold adds Legal / Compliance because a patient's medical record leaves the clinic to an unrelated external party.
factor: disclosure of protected health information to an outside recipient
note: Facts were correct and both sets share Privacy / Confidentiality; the assessor treated the regulatory breach as a consequence of the leak rather than a second direct harm. The blind audit also favoured the single label, so the gold's second label is debatable.
